title: Extending a Boolean assignment
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers, let $\mathrm{pad}$ assign a Boolean value to each of the $n$ indices, and let $y$ assign a Boolean value to each of the $m$ indices. Define an assignment on the $n$ indices by using $y(i)$ when $i<m$, and using $\mathrm{pad}(i)$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment of Boolean values to the $n$ indices
An assignment of Boolean values to the $m$ indices
